description: The input hash in every projection header. The header names the inputs as house.toml, principles/*.md, charter/core.md, charter/provisions/*.md, reflexes/*.md, voice.md. A spec ending in /*.md is every regular *.md file directly in that directory, in code point order of its name; other specs are single files. Absent files are skipped. The hash is sha256 over the UTF-8 of, for each present file in spec order, <house-relative path with / separators>\n<content-hash>\n, where content-hash is sha256 hex of the file's text after dropping a leading BOM and turning CRLF into LF (schema/conformance/hash). Each vector plants files (house-relative path to text) in an empty directory; input-paths and input-hash are what a reader must compute.

vectors.name: every spec present, in spec order rather than path order
CRLF line endings and a BOM hash as their LF, BOM-free text
the LF, BOM-free twin of the previous vector
directory files are ordered by code point, not UTF-16 unit; non-.md files and subdirectories are not inputs
